prep.content: Some people believe that students should be allowed to choose their own school subjects from an early age, rather than following a fixed curriculum.

prompt: Do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Give reasons and examples to support your answer.

prep.content: Hi! I just found out our team meeting got moved to 8 AM tomorrow instead of 2 PM. I know that's really early for you — are you still able to make it, or should we look at rescheduling?

prompt: Reply to this message. Explain whether the new time works for you and suggest an alternative if it doesn't.

prep.content: A recent study found that employees who work from home report higher job satisfaction, but many managers worry that remote work reduces collaboration and creativity.

prompt: What is your opinion on remote work? Discuss the advantages and disadvantages based on the passage and your own experience.

prep.content: Attention residents: the building's water will be shut off tomorrow from 9 AM to 1 PM for scheduled maintenance. Please store water in advance if needed.

prompt: Imagine a neighbor asks you about this notice. Explain what is happening and what they should do to prepare.

prep.content: Many schools are reducing the amount of homework given to students, arguing that free time is just as important for learning as classwork.

prompt: Do you think less homework benefits students? Explain your opinion with specific reasons.

prep.content: Some companies now require employees to come into the office five days a week, reversing the remote and hybrid policies many adopted in recent years.

prompt: Do you agree with requiring employees to work from the office full-time? Give reasons and examples to support your answer.

prep.content: Hey, I'm really sorry but something came up and I can't make it to dinner tonight. Can we reschedule for another day this week? I feel bad cancelling so last minute.

prompt: Reply to this message. Let your friend know how you feel about the change and suggest a new plan.

prep.content: A new study found that people who take a short walk after eating a meal have significantly better blood sugar control than those who remain seated.

prompt: What is your reaction to this finding? Discuss whether you think this would be easy or difficult to build into a daily routine.

prep.content: Notice to gym members: due to renovations, the second-floor weights area will be closed starting Monday. Members are welcome to use the ground-floor equipment during this time.

prompt: Imagine a friend at the gym asks you about this notice. Explain what is happening and what they should do instead.

prep.content: Many parents are concerned about how much time teenagers spend on social media, while others argue it helps young people stay connected with friends and current events.

prompt: What is your opinion on social media use among teenagers? Explain your view with specific reasons and examples.

prep.content: Some people believe that grocery stores should stop offering plastic bags entirely and require customers to bring their own reusable ones.

prompt: Do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Give reasons and examples to support your answer.

prep.content: Hey, would you mind covering my shift on Saturday? A relative is visiting from out of town and I completely forgot I already agreed to work. I'll owe you one!

prompt: Reply to this message. Explain whether you can help and suggest what should happen if you can't.

prep.content: A recent study found that people who listen to instrumental background music while studying retain more information than those who study in silence or with lyrical music.

prompt: What is your reaction to this finding? Discuss whether it matches your own experience with studying or working.

prep.content: Notice to office staff: the main parking garage will be closed for structural repairs starting next Monday. Employees are asked to use the overflow lot two blocks away during this time.

prompt: Imagine a coworker asks you about this notice. Explain what is happening and what they should do instead.

prep.content: Some educators argue that public speaking should be a required class in every school, since many students graduate without ever learning how to speak confidently in front of others.

prompt: Do you think public speaking classes should be mandatory? Explain your opinion with specific reasons and examples.
